_complete_example.name: example_geometry
_complete_example.description: A minimal example geometry package with 2 layers and 3 axioms.
_complete_example.author: Example Author

layers.name: incidence
layers.description: Basic incidence between points and lines.

axioms.name: Two-Point Incidence
axioms.signature: forall (A B : Point), A != B -> exists! (l : Line), on(A, l) AND on(B, l)

axioms.name: Non-Collinearity
axioms.signature: exists (A B C : Point), ~collinear(A, B, C)

layers.independence_notes: I1 and I2 are independent of each other.

layers.name: parallels

axioms.name: Parallel Postulate
axioms.signature: forall (A : Point) (l : Line), ~on(A, l) -> exists (m : Line), on(A, m) AND ~intersect(l, m)

layers.independence_notes: Parallel postulate is independent of incidence axioms.

_notes: 2. Layers MUST be ordered by logical dependency (layer 0 depends on nothing, layer 1 depends on layer 0, etc.)
3. depends_on lists layer NAMES, not axiom IDs
4. primitive_relations should list ALL primitive relations used in the axiom signature
5. Use 'inherits_from' when reusing axioms from another package to avoid duplication
6. References should include author, title, year, and preferably a DOI or URL
7. After creating the manifest, register the package in INDEX.json
8. Each axiom should have a corresponding definition in a .lvz file
